svg.aria-label: The hero I follow: Jake Sully, Toruk Makto. Original illustration of Jake in his Na'vi form.
svg.title: The Hero I Follow · Jake Sully

g.text: Toruk Makto · Olo'eyktan of the Omatikaya
"Sometimes your whole life boils down to one insane move."
He arrived knowing nothing and learned a whole world. That is how I approach every new stack.
